primary.title: SGB 2019-20 Series VI premature redemption today: Investors to earn up to 275% gains; check RBI fixed price
primary.summary: Sovereign Gold Bonds: RBI has fixed the premature redemption price of SGB 2019-20 Series VI at ₹14,213 per gram. Investors who purchased the bonds at the original issue price can earn capital gains of up to 275%, excluding interest and taxes.
